description: Scorched near black, embers banked in every crack. A Slagling's last warmth: it warms the blade and the hide behind it.
lore: Most hard pieces go into the bag. This one goes into a pocket, and a great many never come out again: the seams stay lit, a low orange banked down in the cracks that has never yet been seen to go out. In a blade it is a poor bargain and the trade says so — the edge runs a little warm, and that is the whole of it.

The quarrel about them is old and fair. A teller will point out that warmth is not [[lore/the_age_of_fires|a fire]] — a fire is warmth with somebody talking beside it — and the two ought not to be confused. The ones who walk the black rock, where the rota lapsed further back than anyone can date and the nearest tended fire is a day down the mountain, answer that up there a warm thing in the pocket is not an argument about anything. It is company.

[[characters/cfe826c1|Jehanne]] keeps fires for a living and a [[monsters/lava_poring|Slagling's]] ember in her coat, so both sides of the quarrel claim her. She lets them. A woman who prays without believing has room, she says, to be right in both directions.
